what_it_measured.text: We investigated the occluded essential vessel tributaries, both arterial and venous, occluded superior mesenteric vein and artery in rats, consequent noxious syndrome, peripherally and centrally.
The protein concentration was determined using a commercial kit.

dose.text: Rats received BPC 157 medication (10 µg/kg, 10 ng/kg) intraperitoneally at 1 min ligation-time.
Treatments were given intraperitoneally (1 mL/rat via an abdominal bath) at 1 min after ligation: 10 µg/kg BPC 157, 10 ng/kg BPC 157 or 5 mL/kg saline.

endpoint.text: The experimental results were assessed by observers blinded to the treatment of each animal. 2.2.
Representative tissue specimens were embedded in paraffin, sectioned at 4 µm, stained with haematoxylin and eosin (H&E), and evaluated by light microscopy.
